description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Wrieg], ATK +500 to user

description.name: Mode
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 2 additional time, Cap Break Level 1 to Earth Abilities, Earth Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Earth Abilities; Ends after using 8 Earth abilities. Cast one single AOE Earth/NE jump attack at True Cap Break Level 1 when TP level reaches 6.

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
One single-target Earth/NE piercing jump attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast & Zero SB Cost, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user. 
[Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)] & [Earth 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)] to user, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has 0-749/750+ SB points
WS Blue: Grant [No Soul Break Cost (Tactical, max 1)] to user
WS Gold: Grant [Earth Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)] & [Quadracast Earth 1] to user

description.name: Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Earth attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Earth 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Earth ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: No Soul Break Cost (Tactical, max 1)
description.text: Soul Breaks don't cost SB points, removed after casting a Soul Break or if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Earth Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 50% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]
